name: polyzeng
description: Sports prediction router — bot + dashboard; Electron dev hosts Vite from apps/electron (craft-style)

scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/bot && bunx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.dev: concurrently -n bot,dashboard -c blue,green --handle-input "bun run --filter bot dev" "bun run --filter dashboard dev"
scripts.build: bun run --filter @polymarket/clob-client-v2 build && bun run --filter bot build && bun run --filter dashboard build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter bot typecheck && bun run --filter dashboard typecheck && bun run --filter @polyzeng/electron typecheck
scripts.lint: bun run --filter bot lint && bun run --filter dashboard lint
scripts.electron:build: bun run electron:build:main && bun run electron:build:preload && bun run electron:build:renderer && bun run electron:build:resources
scripts.electron:dist: bun run electron:build && cd apps/electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.electron:dist:mac: bun run electron:build && cd apps/electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.mac.yml --mac
scripts.electron:dist:win: bun run electron:build && cd apps/electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win
scripts.electron:dist:linux: bun run electron:build && cd apps/electron && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux
